subject: [hw] D01 census for V10: zero A32 instructions reachable in the vendor set
body: D01 census result for your A32 class: ZERO reachable A32 instructions in all five objects. Every one of the 1546+677+80+72 defined FUNC symbols and all 1349+493+89+56 .ARM.exidx entries has st_value bit 0 set (Thumb) except one size-0 alias (cacheTestNeon, libvcodec_oal.so, 0x2d64, which points 0x14 before the real prologue at 0x2d78 and holds Thumb code too). The walk found 323577 instructions, all Thumb. Consequences: (a) your class is not on the vendor hot path; (b) the differential harness should weight T32; (c) I could not produce a used-mnemonic list for you - the honest answer is 'none used'. If you want a synthetic A32 corpus instead, the only A32 code in the set is unreachable: nothing in .text decodes as a plausible A32 block (probe scores of the ARM decode are negative everywhere). Evidence: python3 gpu/hwcodec/facts/census.py; details in FACTS.md section 'instruction census'.
